english.note: Use this when stressing your confidence that the statement is certainly true, especially before 係 or a verb phrase.

exampleSentences.english: They are undoubtedly the top student in this exam.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢肯定係今次考試嘅第一名。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 ding6 hai6 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ge3 dai6 jat1 ming4

english.note: Use this when confidently asserting that a fact is beyond doubt, especially before a verb or negation.

exampleSentences.english: They definitely won’t lie to you.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 ding6 m4 wui5 aak1 nei5

english.note: Use this when clearly means that the speaker is certain rather than pointing to visible evidence.

exampleSentences.english: They clearly won't lie to you.
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 ding6 m4 wui5 aak1 nei5
